# Set Up

This example uses the bundled synthetic reporting results, ActionLog and
quarantine audit from `gsm.core`, generated with `gsm.datasim`. The adjusted
score and per-KRI detail come from the same `Analyze_ActionRiskScore()` call
used by the metric workflow. Original KRI flags and the Site Risk Score remain
unchanged.

Open and Closed dispositions retain their weights. An unambiguous No Action
snapshot within 90 days can exclude a contribution when snapshot scoring is
explicitly enabled. These are labelled snapshot-date proxies, not verified
human-action timestamps. Missing evidence retains the contribution. A synthetic
signal with a missing KRI identifier blocks exclusions for its site only.
Earlier flagged findings that are now green retain their Closed review evidence.

The reporting archive runs from February to April 2025, spanning 59 days.
It does not demonstrate 90-day expiry; separate synthetic regression scenarios
cover the inclusive day-90 and expired day-91 boundaries.

<details>
<summary>Setup</summary>

```{r, warning=FALSE}
# Load libraries
library(gsm.core)
library(gsm.kri)
library(here)

dfMetrics <- gsm.core::reportingMetrics %>%
  dplyr::filter(MetricID == "Analysis_kri0001") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    MetricID = "Analysis_kri9999",
    Metric = "Retired Metric",
    Abbreviation = "RET",
    Active = FALSE
  ) %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows(gsm.core::reportingMetrics, .)
dfResults <- gsm.core::reportingResults %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    MetricID == "Analysis_kri0001",
    SnapshotDate < max(SnapshotDate)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(MetricID = "Analysis_kri9999") %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows(gsm.core::reportingResults, .)

latest_snapshot <- max(gsm.core::reportingResults$SnapshotDate)
weights <- gsm.kri::MakeWeights(gsm.core::reportingMetrics)
active_site_metrics <- gsm.core::reportingMetrics %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$GroupLevel == "Site", .data$Active %in% TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::pull("MetricID")
current_kri_results <- gsm.core::reportingResults %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$SnapshotDate == latest_snapshot,
    .data$GroupLevel == "Site",
    grepl("^Analysis_kri", .data$MetricID),
    .data$MetricID %in% active_site_metrics
  )
demo_action_log <- gsm.core::reportingActionLog
demo_excluded_signals <- gsm.core::reportingActionLogExcludedSignals
analysis <- gsm.kri::Analyze_ActionRiskScore(
  dfResults = current_kri_results,
  dfWeights = weights,
  dfActionLog = demo_action_log,
  dfExcludedSignals = demo_excluded_signals,
  bUseSnapshotDate = TRUE,
  bScoreSnapshotNoAction = TRUE,
  intActionWindowDays = 90L,
  strActionPolicy = "disposition",
  bActionHistoryComplete = FALSE
)
action_score_detail <- analysis$Analysis_ActionRiskScoreDetail
action_weighted_score <- analysis$Analysis_Summary %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    StudyID = unique(current_kri_results$StudyID),
    SnapshotDate = latest_snapshot
  )

site_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  dfResults,
  action_weighted_score
)

## Site Report
lCharts <- gsm.kri::MakeCharts(
  dfResults = site_results,
  dfGroups = gsm.core::reportingGroups,
  dfMetrics = dfMetrics,
  dfBounds = gsm.core::reportingBounds
)
```

</details>

# Report

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
## Render example report inline using knit_child
child_env <- list2env(
  list(
    params = list(
      lCharts = lCharts,
        dfResults = site_results,
      dfGroups = gsm.core::reportingGroups,
        dfMetrics = dfMetrics,
      strComparisonRiskMetric = "Analysis_srs0002",
      strComparisonRiskLabel = "Adjusted Risk Score (Draft)",
      dfRiskScoreDetail = action_score_detail
    )
  ),
  parent = environment()
)
report_kri <- knitr::knit_child(
  system.file("report", "Report_KRI.Rmd", package = "gsm.kri"),
  envir = child_env,
  quiet = TRUE
)
cat(report_kri, sep = "\n")
```
